scope_statement: Real injury and recovery journeys told for young readers.
source_note: No sources were retrieved. The generation environment had no access to PubMed, Cochrane, the knowledge base or any textbook. The Tier 1 source minimum is NOT met and this draft would not pass Tier 1 in the deployed pipeline.
claims_needing_verification: The injury moment is often less dramatic than people expect.
The hard part is usually the middle months, not the operation.
Trusting the knee again takes longer than being physically ready.
Return is judged on what the knee can do rather than on the calendar.
Accounts here will include people who did not return to their sport.
claims_note: Listed above are the substantive claims, taken from the deepest tier's key learning points. Every factual statement in the page body requires the same verification; these are the ones a reviewer should start with.
gaps_or_uncertainties: No quantitative figure is given anywhere on this page unless it is a definitional range, because none could be verified.
